coverage.description: Delta, State, Snap and Entity histories. Snap fields are partial maps and sets are ordered unique IDs. Known Set overwrites, Unknown Set removes, Add inserts, Del removes and drops an empty set. Entity.snap(v) folds all deltas in the first min(v,len) states, including v=0 empty and oversized v clamped. state(v) instead returns None outside 1..len. now uses latest; set_by scans backward through the prefix for the last Set regardless of whether its value changed; ver_at scans state insertion order backward for a sentence not greater than the query.
